structured.answer: According to the page, the cheapest choice is a securities account at "פסגות" with the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", which ends at about 86,492 ₪ after ten years (10,000 now plus 500 a month), but I won't do anything before I ask you or someone at the bank, because I don't know this Psagot company or what "מחקה" means.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the headline and the buttons
stuck.why: It opens with 'להשקיע במדד' and English letters (S&P 500, MSCI), so it felt like the page wasn't for me. I only carried on because of the task.
I didn't know whether to change the 10,000 and the 500 already in them. I left them as they were.
Red minus signs next to Leumi, Hapoalim and Discount scared me. I'm not sure whether that's a loss or just less than Psagot.
Too busy: lots of coloured tags, English names, minuses. I stopped there.

used: The headline 'איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד'
The boxes: today's amount 10,000, monthly deposit 500, 10 years, 7%
The bank list with minus signs (Leumi −3,096, Hapoalim −5,021, Mizrahi −8,797)
skimmed: The coloured bar and legend at the top of screen 2 (account fees, fund, tax)
The coloured tags on the funds (צוברת, עסקת החלף, חשיפה לדולר)
The small grey lines under each bank
skipped: The folds next to the banks ('לא בחישוב...')
unsure_meaning: מדד (in the sense of a stock index)
The minuses next to the banks: a loss, or just 'less than'?
not_found: Whether this is safe like a deposit, or whether it can drop
Who is behind this site (I only saw 'מקור')
A plain sentence telling me what to do

findings.what: Dark background with small, pale grey text that's hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: The whole page, especially the lines under the banks and the tags

findings.what: Opens with English letters and investment words, nothing about deposits or safety
Red minus signs next to the familiar banks are scary and don't say what they mean
Lots of numbers and coloured tags on every fund, makes me anxious
Doesn't say whether the 7% is guaranteed or whether the money can go down
The cheapest pick is a company I don't know (פסגות), not my bank
Fund names are full of English letters and codes
